 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Houston Rockets guard Amen Thompson is coming off a game where he had 26 points, 7 rebounds, and 7 assists on 8/11 and 3/3 from three-point range, but won't play on Monday against the Heat because of a sore knee.
 Houston Rockets Guard Thompson Out
 GettyWASHINGTON, DC – NOVEMBER 15: Amen Thompson #1 of the Houston Rockets goes to the basket in front of Alex Sarr #20 and Anthony Davis #23 of the Washington Wizards during the first half at Capital One Arena on November 15, 2026 in Washington, DC. NOTE TO USER: User expressly acknowledges and agrees that, by downloading and or using this photograph, User is consenting to the terms and conditions of the Getty Images License Agreement. (Photo by Scott Taetsch/Getty Images)
 Thompson is the Rockets' best perimeter defender and most athletic player. It's hard to stop him when he gets downhill towards the rim. He can jump out of the building and is an amazing rebounder for a guard. In fact, he's a great rebounder overall, not just as a guard. Thompson guards every team's best player every night and never takes plays off.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He is a key part of this Houston team, and the Rockets will need to find production from someone else. As of right now, it doesn't seem to be a big issue, though, and the injury is just deemed knee soreness.
 Next Man Up
 GettyHOUSTON, TEXAS – NOVEMBER 09: Reed Sheppard #15 of the Houston Rockets shoots the ball against Cameron Johnson #23 of the Denver Nuggets during the first half at Toyota Center on November 09, 2026 in Houston, Texas.  With Thompson sidelined, Reed Sheppard will likely get an expanded role. A player like Sheppard is someone who's trying to fight and earn more minutes in a game. Monday night will be his opportunity to do so.
